messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're doing a branch lock in ~90m for the v1.9.0 release. Please: bump package/version numbers, add changelog entries under 'Unreleased', and make sure any release-blocking PRs are either merged or flagged now. Planned ship: tomorrow 18:00 PT. If you need an exception, call it out here.
kevin: On it — PR #342 (api-rate-limiter) is failing a linter test, fixing now. ETA ~15–25m.
devon: DB migration PR #355 needs one more pass (schema rename). tagging @ashwin for the migration plan and rollback notes.
ashwin: I can review in ~10m. FYI the migration requires a short downtime for the alter; ops confirmed ~2m lock if we coordinate canary.
ci-bot: Job: tests/unit on PR #342 failed (flake8). Log: `E302 expected 2 blank lines, found 1` — see https://ci.redwood.internal/342/build/17 :warning:
kevin: ack, fixing style now. Also pinging @maria about whether we should include the v1.9.0 migration banner in the changelog (breaking change).
maria: Yes — include it under "Unreleased -> Breaking changes" with a 1-line note and link to #355. Keep it concise.
devon: After @ashwin reviews I'll re-run migration smoke tests in staging and push the merge. Might slip into the lock window if review goes long.
ashwin: I'll prioritize it. If it looks hairy we should skip the change and ship a patch next week instead.
maria: If we expect a slip, I'll prep the announcement copy for #announcements. Quick template: `v1.9.0 release delayed by ~X hours due to DB migration review. ETA new ship time: <time>. We will post updates here.` Keep it short.
kevin: Fixed the flake in #342, CI rerun queued. 
ci-bot: Job queued: tests/unit for PR #342 (build 18).
devon: @ashwin merged comments addressed. Requesting final approval.
ashwin: LGTM, approving. Please rebase onto release/v1.9 before merge.
kevin: Merged #342 into release/v1.9. Running final smoke suite.
devon: Merged #355 after rebase. Running staging migration test: tail logs show no errors so far.
maria: Great — because both merged we will still proceed with the lock. Locking branch in 20m. Reminder of the bump command for anyone who hasn't done it: ```bash
# from repo root
git checkout release/v1.9
./scripts/bump-version.sh 1.9.0
git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "chore(release): bump v1.9.0"
git push origin release/v1.9
```
Also tag: `git tag -a v1.9.0 -m "v1.9.0"`
kevin: Smoke suite green. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Canary scheduled: 30m after lock. If any high-severity errors appear within the first 10m of canary, auto-rollback will trigger.
maria: Thanks all. If anything changes and we need to slip, call it out here and I'll post to #announcements with the template above. Otherwise expect the public announcement after success of canary. :party_parrot:
